key_reasoning.reason: New analytics sync subsystem with many components: install/status/run/uninstall runners, config-store, marker, window, identity, policy, report-builder, redact, a cross-platform OS scheduler (launchd/systemd+loginctl/schtasks generators and register/unregister wiring) and a webhook delivery target. It also modifies the analytics CLI wiring, bin/codemie.js, shared src/utils/errors.ts and a new shared src/utils/scheduled-run.ts. Base L, bumped to XL for the new external webhook integration.

No exact precedent for OS scheduler registration across 3 platforms. A signed webhook URL (sig= query param) needs redaction across errors, logs and cause chains. Delivery hardening adds a redirect block, a 5-minute timeout and a 70 MB size cap. A follow-up 'harden' commit signals rework. Base L, bumped to XL for secret handling (security).

Diffstat: 42 files changed, 4774 insertions. About 24 are new source and test files under src/cli/commands/analytics/sync/ (including scheduler/ and targets/), plus new src/utils/scheduled-run.ts and an integration test. Roughly 9 existing files changed across src/, bin/, docs/ and .ai-run/guides/. This is well beyond the 16+ XXL threshold.

Touches the CLI/API command surface, service logic (run-sync, report-builder), local persistence (config-store and marker files), infrastructure (OS scheduler units/plists/tasks) and an external HTTPS webhook. Base L, bumped to XL for the external integration.
